description: Get a website's DESIGN.md design-system spec by slug. Use `sections` to fetch only the headings you need (response lists availableSections), and format `json` for structured tokens instead of Markdown. `version` selects a historical revision (see list_revisions). Pro sites return prose plus a token preview unless called by a Pro account (OAuth or API key).

format.description: md (default) = DESIGN.md text; json = structured tokens

sections.description: Section headings to include (case-insensitive, partial match), e.g. ["Colors", "Typography"]

name: get_design_md
title: Get DESIGN.md
